You ever wonder what it would look like to brand one's body of work as a “design practice” while maintaining an individual presence?.

I have, and so I made a website for myself. Well, the individual version of myself. The goal was to create a clear separation of the “founder” so that people who may be interested in hiring an individual over a studio would have a place to be pointed to while solidifying this whole “Ernie is the voice of Studio Ernie” idea I’ve had.

Plenty of gurus will write long LinkedIn posts about this sort of thing, a founder first approach where the founder builds a brand to build an audience to point said audience to their product or service.

This wasn’t that.
